data.standardized_narrative: The balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year (1 Jan 2018, comparative column) of approximately GBP 254.1m. The report does not provide a clearly legible, explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure in the visible movement notes; therefore a quantified prior-year development (gross) could not be extracted with confidence from the available pages.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: many numeric lines and notes in the PDF images are rotated and low-resolution. The balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year figure was read as GBP 254.1m on the balance sheet comparative column (page 9) but some surrounding lines were not fully legible. A clear GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (the required authoritative source for prior year development) was not unambiguously readable in the available images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. The gross written premium total (555.2) is taken from the report header/financial highlights (consistent with the segmental table) but detailed segment amounts in the segmental table were not reliably legible, so the premium mix includes class names copied as printed but without confident numeric splits. The claims development triangle and technical provisions notes appear in the report but were not extracted reliably enough to compute a gross PYD; if higher-resolution pages are supplied I can compute the prior-year movement and populate the triangle.
